description: Estaciones Base is a series of datasets listed in Chilean national open data portal (datos.gob.cl), an open data portal, published or maintained by Subsecretaría de Telecomunicaciones. Estaciones Base. Coverage: Chile. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Subsecretaría de Telecomunicaciones. Its tags are telecomunicaciones. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2016-02-17 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-cl-portal.
